summary: RedLynx's physics-based motorcycle obstacle series, from Java and Flash prototypes through Xbox Live Arcade, Ubisoft console/PC entries, mobile spin-offs, and the Blood Dragon crossover.

entries.title: Trials

primary.why: The first Trials is sourced as a 2000 Java/browser game. It is the only sourced version, so the original Java/browser route is the archive primary.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved Java/browser build in a safe legacy runtime or browser-emulation setup if available.

all_releases.reason: primary: sole sourced version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only the original Java/browser version is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Trials games are sequels/remakes, not a direct remaster of this first release.

emulation.notes: Preservation depends on locating a working Java build.

entries.title: Trials 2

emulation.notes: Windows archival access is preferred; Flash preservation may require a safe offline player.

primary.why: Trials 2 is the 2007 predecessor to Trials 2: Second Edition, with browser/Flash and Windows releases. The Windows build has the higher fidelity ceiling, while Second Edition is a separate 2008 remake.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved Windows build if available; otherwise treat the browser/Flash version as the archival fallback.

all_releases.reason: skip: archival route, but Windows has the higher fidelity ceiling where preserved.

all_releases.fidelity: PC route listed in RedLynx's developed-games chronology.
all_releases.reason: primary: best preserved high-fidelity route for the original Trials 2 before the Second Edition remake.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Trials 2: Second Edition is the better-known remake, but the original Trials 2 is kept as a distinct archival entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge this with Trials 2: Second Edition; the 2008 release is a remake/expanded edition with its own entry.

entries.title: Trials 2: Second Edition

emulation.notes: Use Windows compatibility fixes if needed.

primary.why: Trials 2: Second Edition is a Windows remake of Trials 2 with online profiles, achievements, ghost challenges, and multiplayer/high-score features. Windows is the only sourced platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release from an owned copy or preserved installer; expect old online features to depend on server preservation.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release, a 3D-on-2D-plane remake of Trials 2.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole platform and definitive remake route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only Windows is sourced for Second Edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Old website/leaderboard services may not be available in the original form.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is sourced; Flash support requires preservation tools.

entries.title: Trials HD
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360 XBLA release plus Big Pack and Big Thrills DLC

emulation.notes: Use official Xbox backward compatibility where available; ensure DLC ownership/preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox 360 original or compatible Xbox output

primary.version: XBLA release with Big Pack and Big Thrills DLC
primary.why: Trials HD was released for Xbox Live Arcade, with two DLC packs adding official and user-created tracks. A Windows version of its single-player content was later bundled inside Trials Evolution: Gold Edition, but that bundle changes the physics, so the Xbox 360 release with DLC remains the accurate complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 or Xbox One/Series backward compatibility with the DLC packs installed if owned.

all_releases.fidelity: Original XBLA release with DLC packs and original physics.
all_releases.reason: primary: accurate complete version with original physics and DLC.

all_releases.fidelity: Bundled PC version of Trials HD content inside Gold Edition, with changed physics.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful PC access, but not the accurate original-physics version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC-bundled content is more convenient but changes physics; the original Xbox 360 version with DLC is the most faithful complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Gold Edition PC bundle is not a 1:1 replacement because the physics differ.

entries.title: Trials Legends

emulation.notes: Use a trusted archived Windows build.

primary.why: Trials Legends is listed as a 2010 Windows remake/other game in the Trials series and is preserved through public archive listings. Windows is the only sourced platform.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved Windows build from a trusted archive/preservation source.

all_releases.fidelity: Only sourced release, Windows remake/preservation build.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole sourced platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Preservation access is the main issue; no modern official storefront route is sourced.

entries.title: Trials Evolution
entries.definitive_edition: Trials Evolution: Gold Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use PC Gold Edition as primary; emulate/preserve Xbox 360 for comparison and DLC history.

primary.why: Trials Evolution first released on Xbox 360, then came to Windows as Gold Edition with a bundled copy of Trials HD content. Windows Gold Edition has the highest fidelity ceiling and the broadest package, though Trials HD physics differ from the original.
primary.how_to_play: Play Trials Evolution: Gold Edition on Windows if owned; keep the Xbox 360 Trials HD entry separate for original-physics HD content.

all_releases.reason: skip: authentic original, but Windows Gold Edition has the higher fidelity ceiling and bundled HD content.

all_releases.fidelity: Gold Edition PC release bundling Trials Evolution and Trials HD content.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity and broadest package for Evolution.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Gold Edition is broadest for Evolution, but its bundled Trials HD content changes HD physics; use the separate Trials HD Xbox entry for faithful HD.

entries.remaster_caveats: Gold Edition's bundled Trials HD content is not a perfect replacement for Xbox 360 Trials HD.

entries.title: Trials Frontier

emulation.notes: Use preserved installed copies where available.

primary.why: Trials Frontier is a mobile spin-off designed to accompany Trials Fusion and was released for iOS and Android. The iOS row is the concrete primary for the equivalent mobile platform group.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved iOS installation on compatible hardware, or the Android release as an equivalent fallback; expect delisting or online-service limitations.

all_releases.reason: primary: part of the sole sourced mobile platform group.
skip: equivalent mobile route; iOS row carries the single primary for the platform group.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The sourced releases are equivalent mobile routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is sourced; mobile preservation may be limited by delisting or server dependencies.
